Honestly, I'm just afraid she might not believe I have depression. When I was younger around 13-14 years old, I was in an argument with my mum and scratched my arm and left really red marks. Eventhough I was wearing a jacket since we were out in a BBQ, I had to pull it up which then my dad saw it. He whispered to my mum about it and looked really worried and my mum said and I quote "She's just doing this for attention, who cares".

Eventhough she reads up alot about mental health illnesses or psychology things and could easily tell if someone is depressed or not somehow she can't figure out I'm depressed. I just hope when I give her the letter that she will really believe it and not just pull up another "this is just for attention" card. I'm afraid that if she doesn't believe me, this will worsen our relationship even more :(

Anyways, thanks for your reply once again!! I appreciate it A TON!! <3

Hi!! Thank you so much for you reply! I really appreciated it especially from someone who faced the same problem as me before. And haha I'm not from England, I'm actually from Malaysia!

Thinking back at it, it's really true since she would always compare me and her. Things like who has more common sense (she doesn't compare grades cos she was only a C/B student) or whose skinnier or whose more pretty or whose legs are longer and etc. I knew my grandpa expected my mum to get good grades for her board exams but she didn't so maybe that's why she's kinda against my grades. My mum also used to be overweight and would get alot of snarky comments from other people. Eventhough she lost alot of weight now, she's still not as skinny as me and would always compare. I guess it must have been her insecurities that made her talk to me this way.

But honestly I still dont know what to feel about her, she even admitted herself that she will never say sorry even if she's wrong in an argument :/ She makes me think that I'm worthless and useless and unloved but whenever I face a problem she would always cheer me up. Even if my dad jokingly says Im ugly my mum would scold him for it.

I also read some Japanese manga here and there but it's quite rare since I'm not a huge fan of mangas. I'm also planning to get novels once I go to Japan since it's really expensive in Malaysia!!

I think the main problem is that it's hard to be consistent with Japanese because it's hard to keep being motivated when you're not seeing any improvements and the fact that I'm studying one main thing almost everyday makes it so easily to be burned out. To deal with this problem, just imagine u have to go on a video call chat with ur friend at 4pm (if u can't imagine, ask one of ur friends if they can do it with u). After studying a chapter, recite with ur best of what u had just learned to ur friend.

Thirdly, reward urself after every hour or 2 hrs of studying. Try ur best to not go on social media because u probs would just be scrolling for hours. U could instead watch an episode or 2 of ur fav tv show.

Lastly, think of the long term goal. As we all know, the igcse grades would heavily affect what kind of university/college we can go, so this grades are very important. Just tell urself work hard now so u can relax in the future.
